settings.cut_policy: Only longest verified quiet interior run of each source punctuation gap; preserve stronger activity and never force target gap duration.

tool_versions.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

limitations: No subjective listening approval is claimed.
Machine word alignment and signal thresholds cannot perfectly classify breaths or phonemes; user audition remains essential.
Conservative criteria deliberately leave gaps longer than targets where stronger activity or uncertain timing prevents safe trimming.
Full-episode potential is limited to this exact method and its numerical screening, not a maximal possible edit or permission to execute it.
